comments.content: [medium] Putting ActivityComponent on the hidden components list is wrong: it stands for user-rendered content, not an internal implementation detail, so it needs to remain visible in React DevTools.

[medium] This function largely repeats the Offscreen/LegacyHidden mounting and updating pattern (creating/updating an Offscreen fiber, wiring `ref`, `child`, and `return`). Pulling that into a shared helper — or reusing `updateOffscreenComponent`/`updateLegacyHiddenComponent` if the semantics line up — would reduce the risk of divergence when Offscreen behavior changes (e.g. flags, lanes, ref handling). If the semantics are intentionally different, a short comment explaining why Activity needs its own fork would be helpful.

[medium] It may be worth checking whether 'Activity' as the component name matches the naming conventions used elsewhere in the codebase. If a constant or shared definition for this name already exists, reusing it would likely be better than hardcoding the string here.

[medium] Placing `REACT_ACTIVITY_TYPE` ahead of `REACT_OFFSCREEN_TYPE` would keep the definitions alphabetical, which appears to be the ordering pattern elsewhere in this file (lazy, memo, offscreen, scope, etc.) and would make the symbol definitions easier to maintain.
[low] A targeted test for `getComponentNameFromFiber` with a malformed value would help define the rejection behavior.
[low] Please verify that `isValidElementType` does not silently discard information needed by the next stage.
